comment: The input rules of the panel API and the agent. The generator agent/cmd/cf-rules writes the Go checks (agent/internal/validate/rules_gen.go) and the PHP rules (api/app/Validation/InputRules.php) from this file. Refer to schema/README.md.

unixUser.doc: The Unix user of a website, for example "acme_x7k2".
unixUser.message: Use a name such as acme_x7k2: a letter, at most 15 letters or digits, an underscore, and 4 letters or digits.

routePath.doc: The path prefix of the route of a website in the edge proxy, for example "/01jbq3z5k8n6/". It starts and ends with a slash, and has 1 to 40 lower-case letters and digits.
routePath.message: Use a path such as /01jbq3z5k8n6/: a slash, 1 to 40 lower-case letters and digits, and a slash.

domain.doc: A domain name in lower case. Each label has 1 to 63 characters. The last label is not a number, so that the name is not an IP address (audit finding R5).
domain.message: Enter a domain name in lower-case letters, for example shop.example.com.

id.message: Enter an ID of 26 letters and digits.

databaseName.doc: The full name of a database or a database user.
databaseName.message: Use 2 to 63 lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Start with a letter.

databaseNameSuffix.doc: The part of a database name that the user types. The panel puts the Unix user of the website and an underscore before it (CF-01).
databaseNameSuffix.message: Use 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Start with a letter or a digit.

imageReference.doc: An image reference with no tag. It starts with the host name of a registry: a name with a dot or a port, or "localhost". Podman would search a short name such as "nginx" in its default registries (audit finding R5).
imageReference.message: Enter an image reference with its registry and no tag, for example ghcr.io/team/app.

imageTag.message: Use 1 to 128 letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens. Do not start with a dot or a hyphen.

image.doc: An image reference with a tag: the rules imageReference and imageTag with ":" between them.
image.message: Enter an image reference with its registry and a tag, for example ghcr.io/team/app:1.2.

digest.doc: The digest of an image. An empty digest is permitted.
digest.message: Enter a digest: sha256: and 64 hexadecimal digits in lower case.

phpExtension.doc: The name of a PHP extension.
phpExtension.message: Use 1 to 40 lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

iniKey.doc: The name of a php.ini setting.
iniKey.message: Use 1 to 64 lower-case letters, underscores and dots.

iniValue.doc: A php.ini value. It is on one line, has no double quotes and does not end with a backslash.
iniValue.message: Use at most 200 characters on one line, with no double quotes and no backslash at the end.

sha256.doc: A SHA-256 hash in lower-case hexadecimal.
sha256.message: Enter 64 hexadecimal digits in lower case.

restorePath.doc: The path of a file or a directory in a website. It starts with "/". It has no empty part, no "." part, no ".." part and no "/" at the end.
restorePath.message: Enter a path that starts with /, for example /public/index.php. Do not use "//", "." or ".." parts, or a / at the end.

documentRoot.doc: A directory in /app, for example "public" or "web/htdocs". "." is /app. It has at most 8 parts. A part does not start with a dot. An empty value is permitted: the agent then uses the default of the image.
documentRoot.message: Enter a directory in /app, for example public or web/htdocs. Use letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, and at most 8 parts.

commandArgument.doc: One argument of the start command of a custom image. It has no control characters.
commandArgument.message: Each argument must have 1 to 1024 characters and no control characters.

sshKey.doc: One public key in the format of authorized_keys, with no options.
sshKey.message: Enter one public SSH key on one line, for example: ssh-ed25519 AAAA... name. Do not put options before the key.

databasePassword.doc: The password of a database user. The panel makes it. It has only letters and digits, so that it needs no quotation marks in a command, in SQL or in a connection address.

databaseClientHost.doc: The host part of a MariaDB user: an address, a network, a host name or a pattern with a percent sign.
databaseClientHost.message: Use an address, a network or a host name. Use only letters, digits and the characters . : % / _ -

mailLocalPart.doc: The part of a mail address before the @ sign, in lower case. It has no plus sign: the mail server uses the text after a plus sign as a tag of the same mailbox.
mailLocalPart.message: Use 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores. Start and end with a letter or a digit.

mailAddress.doc: A mail address in lower case, for example the destination of a forwarder.
mailAddress.message: Enter a mail address in lower-case letters, for example sales@example.com.

mailPasswordHash.doc: The hash of a mailbox password: bcrypt, which the panel makes, or SHA-512-crypt, SHA-256-crypt or MD5-crypt from the import of a different panel. The agent gives it to the mail server. The agent never gets the password.
mailPasswordHash.message: Enter a bcrypt, SHA-512-crypt, SHA-256-crypt or MD5-crypt hash.

dnsRecordName.doc: The name of a DNS record in its zone, without the name of the zone: "@" for the zone itself, "*" for a wildcard, or labels such as "www", "_dmarc" and "*.dev". A label can start with an underscore.
dnsRecordName.message: Use @ for the zone itself, or a name such as www, mail or _dmarc. Use lower-case letters, digits, hyphens and dots. Do not put the name of the zone at the end.

dnsHost.doc: The full host name in the value of a CNAME, NS, MX or SRV record, in lower case, with no dot at the end. A label can start with an underscore. The last label is not a number.
dnsHost.message: Enter a full host name in lower-case letters, for example mail.example.com.

ipv4.doc: An IPv4 address in the usual form, for the value of an A record.
ipv4.message: Enter an IPv4 address, for example 203.0.113.10.

ipv6.doc: An IPv6 address in lower case, for the value of an AAAA record. It has only hexadecimal groups and colons: no IPv4 part and no zone.
ipv6.message: Enter an IPv6 address in lower-case letters, for example 2001:db8::10.

dnsTxt.doc: The text of a TXT record: printable ASCII characters. The agent adds the quotation marks and divides a long text into parts of 255 characters.
dnsTxt.message: Enter 1 to 2048 characters. Use only the letters, digits and signs of ASCII. Do not put quotation marks around the text.

dnsSrv.doc: The value of an SRV record after the priority: the weight, the port and the host name of the target.
dnsSrv.message: Enter the weight, the port and the host name, for example: 5 5060 sip.example.com.

dnsCaa.doc: The value of a CAA record: the flags (0 or 128), the tag and a text in quotation marks. The text has no quotation mark and no backslash.
dnsCaa.message: Enter the flags, the tag and the value in quotation marks, for example: 0 issue "letsencrypt.org".

dnssecKey.doc: The private DNSSEC key of a zone: an ECDSA P-256 key in the PKCS #8 PEM format. The panel makes it.
dnssecKey.message: Enter a private key in the PKCS #8 PEM format.

filePath.doc: The path of a file or a directory in the files of a website, for the file manager. "/" is the directory of the website, which the container has at /app. The path has no empty part, no "." part, no ".." part, no control characters and no "/" at the end.
filePath.message: Enter a path that starts with /, for example /public/index.php. Do not use "//", "." or ".." parts, or a / at the end.

cronSchedule.doc: The schedule of a cron job: minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week, with one space between them. Each field is "*", a number, a range or a list, with an optional step. The day of the week is 0 to 7, and 0 and 7 are Sunday.
cronSchedule.message: Enter 5 fields: minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week. For example */5 * * * * or 0 3 * * 1.

commandLine.doc: One command line for the shell of a website container: the command of a cron job or a build command of a deploy. It is on one line and has no control characters.
commandLine.message: Enter a command of 1 to 1000 characters on one line.

gitRepository.doc: The address of a Git repository: HTTPS with no user name and no password, SSH as a URL, or the short SSH form "git@host:path". It cannot start with "-", and it cannot name a file or a helper program.
gitRepository.message: Enter the address of a Git repository, for example https://github.com/acme/shop.git or git@github.com:acme/shop.git.

gitBranch.doc: The name of a Git branch. It cannot start with "-".
gitBranch.message: Enter the name of a branch, for example main. Use letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens and slashes.

secretName.doc: The name of an environment variable that a deploy gives to the build commands.
secretName.message: Use 1 to 64 capital letters, digits and underscores. Do not start with a digit.

secretValue.doc: The value of a deploy secret. It is on one line.
secretValue.message: Enter a value of 1 to 4096 characters on one line.

envName.doc: The name of an environment variable of a website container. PORT, HOST, HOME, PATH, PWD, SERVER_NAME and the names that start with CF_, FRANKENPHP_, CADDY_, XDG_ or APACHE_ are for the agent and the image: they change the web server of the container.
envName.message: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits and underscores. Do not start with a digit. PORT, HOST, HOME, PATH, PWD, SERVER_NAME and names that start with CF_, FRANKENPHP_, CADDY_, XDG_ or APACHE_ are not available.

envValue.doc: The value of an environment variable of a website container. It is on one line. It can be empty.
envValue.message: Enter a value of up to 4096 characters on one line.

environmentValue.what: value of a container environment variable
environmentValue.doc: The value of an environment variable of a plugin container, for example its token. The agent writes it in the unit of the container, so it has no space, quote, "%", "$" or backslash.
environmentValue.message: Use 1 to 1024 letters, digits and the characters _ . , : / | @ + = ~ -.

securityPath.doc: A path of the protection of a website in the edge proxy, for example "/wp-login.php" or "/admin/". A path that ends with "/" is the directory and all paths in it. The path has no empty part, no "." part and no ".." part. It has no "%" and no "*": the edge proxy compares the decoded path of a request.
securityPath.message: Enter a path that starts with /, for example /wp-login.php or /admin/. Use letters, digits and . _ ~ @ : + , = -. Do not use "//", "." or ".." parts.

pathUser.doc: The user name of a password-protected path of a website. The edge proxy asks for it with HTTP basic authentication.
pathUser.message: Use 1 to 32 letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. Start with a letter or a digit.

pathPasswordHash.doc: The bcrypt hash of the password of a user of a password-protected path. The panel makes it, and the agent gives it to the edge proxy. The agent never gets the password.

packSlug.doc: The name of a pack, for example "golang". It is also the name of the runtime of the pack in the jobs of the agent.
packSlug.message: Use 2 to 31 lower-case letters, digits and "-". The first character is a letter.

packVersion.doc: The version of a pack, for example "1.2.0".

packImageVersion.doc: The version of the runtime in one image of a pack, for example "1.25". Customers select it.
packImageVersion.message: Use up to 16 letters, digits and the characters . + _ -, for example 1.25.

reservedDatabaseNames.doc: Names that the database servers use (CF-01).

reservedDatabasePrefixes.doc: A database name does not start with one of these (CF-01).

dnsRecordTypes.doc: The types of DNS record that a user can make.

reservedRuntimeNames.doc: The names of the built-in runtimes, the image families and the database engines. A pack cannot have one of these names.

commandArguments.doc: The largest number of arguments of a start command.

dnsTtl.doc: The largest TTL of a DNS record, in seconds.

dnsRecordsPerZone.doc: The largest number of records in a DNS zone.

dnsShortTtl.doc: The smallest TTL of a DNS record, in seconds.

dnsZonesPerJob.doc: The largest number of DNS zones in one job of the agent.

cronJobs.doc: The largest number of cron jobs of a website.

buildCommands.doc: The largest number of build commands of a deploy.

deploySecrets.doc: The largest number of secrets of a deploy.

environmentVariables.doc: The largest number of environment variables of a website.

containerEnvironment.doc: The largest number of environment variables of a container.

firewallExclusions.doc: The largest number of firewall rules that a website can turn off.

firewallSkipPaths.doc: The largest number of paths that the firewall of a website does not examine.

firewallRuleId.doc: The largest ID of a firewall rule.

ipRules.doc: The largest number of IP addresses and ranges in the allow list or in the block list of a website.

protectedPaths.doc: The largest number of password-protected paths of a website.

pathUsers.doc: The largest number of users of one password-protected path.

signInPaths.doc: The largest number of sign-in paths of a website.

signInLimit.doc: The largest sign-in limit of a website: POST requests in one minute from one IP address.

lowSignInLimit.doc: The smallest sign-in limit of a website that is not 0.

packImages.doc: The largest number of images in one pack.

packs.doc: The largest number of packs on a panel.

packManifestBytes.doc: The largest size of a pack manifest, in bytes.

certificatesPerServer.doc: The largest number of certificates from the panel on one server.

certificateHosts.doc: The largest number of hosts that use one certificate on one server.

certificateBytes.doc: The largest size of a certificate chain or of a private key in PEM format, in bytes.
